verdict.rationale: ByteAsk documents its own JetBrains connectors for CLion, IDEA and PyCharm, and it presents diffs for review, but the documented diff review happens in the terminal TUI. Nothing shows the connector offering interactive diffs inside the IDE or sending selected code as context. missing for 10: evidence of interactive diff viewing within JetBrains, evidence of sharing selected code as context from the IDE, connector feature documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view interactive diffs and share selected code as context from within my JetBrains IDE

citations.quote: VS Code, Cursor, and JetBrains (CLion, IDEA, PyCharm) connectors are live.
